text: Cream with fat set to the grade and nothing added; sold chilled in 200 ml cartons.

links.name: Commons: Meiji brand fresh cream (photo of the carton label)

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The cream is sterilised by the maker's own method, following the dairy ordinance.
The cream is cooled and left to age, so that it settles before filling.

sources.text: Meiji's two pages: the 18 % minimum with nothing added, and the order of separating, sterilising, homogenising, cooling and ageing, then filling.
